svg.title: Hollow-LLM serving and proof-generation time
svg.desc: Time is normalized to the inner model separately for each phase. The inner model has 6 layers and hidden dimension 512. Hollow A+B and the honest larger reference both declare 12 layers and dimension 1024. Prefill ratios are 1, 1, and 2.4; decode ratios are 1, 1, and 3.1; proof-generation ratios are 1, 4.81, and 4.74. Serving savings do not imply cheaper proofs. Source: Hollow-LLM Table 2.
